title: 2022 Panini Score NFL Micah Parsons Sack Attack #SA-MP Dallas Cowboys
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2022 Panini Score NFL trading card featuring Micah Parsons of the Dallas Cowboys. The card is part of the "Sack Attack" insert set, with card number SA-MP. It is a standard-sized card from the 2022 Score set, manufactured by Panini for the National Football League (NFL) season.
